constitution.title: Claude’s Constitution
constitution.significance: Anthropic describes the values and behavior it aims to develop in Claude.
constitution.connection: The authors use this document to explain what their post-training aimed to encourage. The later evaluations examine how Claude behaves in practice.

hle.title: Humanity’s Last Exam
hle.significance: This evaluation assembles difficult expert-written questions across a range of subjects.
hle.connection: The original benchmark defines the questions. Anthropic compares answers under different tool-access conditions, so the setup matters when reading its accuracy results.

wandr.title: WANDR: Wide and Deep Research
wandr.significance: WANDR tests whether a research agent can gather information across many distinct entities as well as track down details about them.
wandr.connection: The report uses WANDR to examine broad information gathering. A system may find one example easily and still struggle to complete an entire collection.

occurrences.excerpt: After pretraining, the model underwent substantial post-training and fine-tuning to make it an assistant whose behavior aligns with the values described in Claude’s constitution.
occurrences.rationale: The authors use this document to explain what their post-training aimed to encourage. The later evaluations examine how Claude behaves in practice.

occurrences.excerpt: Humanity’s Last Exam (HLE) is a multimodal benchmark of 2,500 questions spanning dozens of subjects.
occurrences.rationale: The original benchmark defines the questions. Anthropic compares answers under different tool-access conditions, so the setup matters when reading its accuracy results.

occurrences.excerpt: WANDR (Wide ANd Deep Research) is a benchmark from Perplexity intended as a wide-search counterpart to the DRACO deep research benchmark.
occurrences.rationale: The report uses WANDR to examine broad information gathering. A system may find one example easily and still struggle to complete an entire collection.
